_comment: Cloud database security rules, one entry per PHYSICAL collection (kedupan_ prefix, shared test environment). Every collection is deny-all for clients: the game never touches the database directly; cloud functions run with admin rights and bypass these rules. Paste each value into the console (Database > collection > Permissions > custom rules). Why each collection needs deny-all is in _why.

_why.kedupan_daily_sets: holds the answer anchors of open days; only functions may shape what leaves
_why.kedupan_daily_card_stats: raw national histograms; clients get only revealed refs through functions
_why.kedupan_daily_entries: every player's answers (openid + positions); boards are served hashed by functions
_why.kedupan_player_stats: streaks per openid; read through getDaily/getArchive
_why.kedupan_group_members: maps openid to group (openGId, groupRef); must never be readable
_why.kedupan_group_daily: cached group trend; derived from member answers
_why.kedupan_rounds: holds the hidden target until reveal; any client read would leak it
_why.kedupan_guesses: each guess with openid and group tag; served as salted hashes after reveal only
_why.kedupan_sub_grants: subscribe opt-ins per openid; written and claimed by functions
_why.kedupan_item_usage: which items were published; server scheduling state
_why.kedupan_events: analytics with openid; written by track only
_why.kedupan_rate_limits: server counters; a writable limiter would be bypassable
_why.kedupan_app_config: ad and subscribe configuration set in the console; clients receive it only as features from getDaily
_why.kedupan_reveal_views: records that a player was served the answer of a revealed round (closes late guessing for them); openid per round
_why.kedupan_meta: launch date and other server constants
_why.kedupan_mod_log: typed-clue moderation evidence: openid, verdict, trace id and the blocked text; admin only (admin function)
_why.kedupan_mod_quota: daily WeChat text-check counters (dev budget, volume and busy alerts); server state only
_why.kedupan_clue_reports: who reported which clue and why; the reporter is never shown to anyone, the host included
_why.kedupan_audit_log: every admin takedown, restriction and switch with before/after; accountability record, admin only
